core_insight.source_excerpt: Vision: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on leveraging existing foundation models and providing a full observe-intelligence-execution loop to continuously identify and deploy AI agents for work automation, rather than just offering AI tools or custom LLMs.
core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot effectively observe work patterns or if AI automation opportunities are not accurately identified, then Narma will fail to deliver continuous AI lift and ROI, losing its value proposition.

raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It comprises three layers: Observe (desktop sensors for work patterns), Intelligence Layer (detects employee intent, task value, and "drift"), and Execution Layer (Agent Factory for generating, deploying, and monitoring AI agents). It leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify efficient AI intervention points for "Continuous AI lift."
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its integrated three-layered architecture that observes work patterns, detects intent and value, and autonomously deploys AI agents using existing foundation models. It focuses on the "Work Graph" to pinpoint high-ROI opportunities and ensure continuous AI lift, rather than building custom LLMs or providing disconnected AI tools.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.thesis: Narma proposes to solve the challenge of deploying AI automation at scale within enterprises by providing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain." This venture aims to help AI-first companies measure, validate, and implement AI solutions by observing work patterns, identifying high-ROI automation opportunities, and automatically generating and deploying AI agents. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an "Observe" layer to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" to detect employee intent and business value, and an "Execution Layer" to deploy AI agents. Narma differentiates itself by focusing on the "Work Graph" and leveraging existing foundation models, rather than developing its own LLMs. This allows them to identify inefficiencies and intercede with AI assistance directly within existing workflows. The target users are AI-first companies that struggle with quantifying AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and process drift. The problem is severe and frequent, as enterprises often lack the telemetry to effectively deploy and measure AI automation. The founder's goal appears to be building a growth startup, given the emphasis on "at scale" deployment and continuous AI lift. Currently, the venture is at the idea stage, with a clear architectural vision but no mention of development or user traction.

market_data.trigger_now: Enterprises struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.
